name: Love Semi ~Koi no Tokubetsu Shidoushitsu~
original_name: ラブゼミ～恋の特別指導室～
source:
Main character enters a private academy with "priority guidance system" and emphasis on interviews. But what "priority guidance system" actually means?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-october-2001-jisatsu-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]

主人公进入一所强调面谈、设有“优先指导制度”的私立学园。
但所谓“优先指导制度”，究竟意味着什么？
